user.title: Name your news desk
user.description: One Briefly entry is one news desk, for example "Kiosk news". Its sensors are named after it.

section.title: Add a section
section.description: Sections added so far: {count}. Each section is one column of news.

data.add_another: Add another section after this one

data_description.section_name: Shown as the column heading, for example UK, Politics or Sport.
data_description.colour: Accent colour for this section on dashboards.
data_description.feeds: Tick the sources this section should show. Every preset allows automated fetching, so summaries can be written for it.
data_description.custom_feeds: Any other RSS or Atom feed, one URL per line. Briefly checks each one before saving.

summaries.title: Summaries
summaries.description:
Briefly can write a short summary of each story with a local AI model running in Ollama. With summaries off, each story shows the description from its feed.

Don't have Ollama yet? Download it from {ollama_url}.

ollama.title: Ollama server
ollama.description:
Enter the address of your Ollama server. If you already use Home Assistant's Ollama integration ({ha_ollama_url}) its address is filled in for you.

To install Ollama, see {ollama_url}.

model.title: Model
model.description: Pick a model installed on your Ollama server. Choosing the same model as Home Assistant's Ollama integration (currently {ha_model}) avoids loading a second model onto the GPU.

voice.title: Spoken headlines (optional)
voice.description:
Briefly can read headlines aloud on Amazon Echo devices using the `briefly.speak_headlines` action.

This needs **Alexa Media Player**, a separate custom integration that you install from HACS ({alexa_media_url}). It is not part of Briefly or of Home Assistant.

data_description.alexa_targets: Media players created by Alexa Media Player.
